name: @gnosia/schema
//: No build step. The package is consumed only by other workspaces that run through tsx or vitest, both of which resolve the npm workspace symlink to its real path outside node_modules and transpile the TypeScript directly. Publishing is not a goal; if it ever is, add a build and point exports at dist/.
//exports: Every key here must be "." or start with "./": Node rejects the whole package config otherwise, so a comment cannot live inside the exports object. ./shared is the constants and the plain types with no drizzle import, so a client component in src/ can take the recap bounds from the same definition the CHECK constraints are built from without pulling a Postgres driver into the browser bundle.
